name: Broken Epoch: Wit Cards
detailed_description:
This is a strategy game that combines deep card-building with fast-paced auto chess. You will collect hundreds of uniquely styled cards, build your own deck, and strategize in 6-player battles to emerge as the ultimate victor!

Game Worldview

According to the Continental Chronicle, during the great catastrophe known as the "Earth Pulse Resonance" in the year 1387 of the Holy Spirit Calendar, the seven ancient continents, once separated, violently collided due to abnormal gravitational tides. Races that once inhabited different continents were forced to share living spaces, thus forming six major factions. The chaotic earth pulse energy condensed into "Soul Energy Crystals" during the collision, and these crystals, imbued with the essence of their respective regions, became the strategic resources of the new epoch. Summoners use Soul Energy Crystals to call forth creatures for battle, engaging in soul wars across battlefields riddled with energy rifts, fighting for the survival rights of their factions.

Card Collection and Strategic Construction

Six factions, 300+ cards: Each faction has unique heroes, races, and tactical positions. Cards are divided into four types: attack, defense, support, and control, each featuring exquisite illustrations and unique skills.

Free construction system: Select 30 core cards from the vast card pool to build your exclusive deck, either focusing on a single card for an ultimate style or mixing multiple factions for complex tactics.

6-Player Auto Chess Battle

Elimination survival competition: 6 players battle simultaneously, competing for the sole survivor through follower recruitment, lineup arrangement, economic management, and positional strategy.

Follower star-up and style combinations: Recruit units from a randomly refreshed follower pool, synthesize identical followers to upgrade stars, and build the ultimate lineup through position placement and skill synergy.

Turn-based Life-and-Death Speed

Preparation phase: Buy pieces, upgrade population, adjust positions.

Battle phase: Pieces automatically fight, with outcomes directly affecting player health.

Elimination phase: Players with zero health are eliminated, and the last survivor wins.

Depth and Randomness Combined

Strategic dimension: From deck building to in-game management, every step requires precise calculation.

Random fun: The unpredictability of follower refreshes and opponent lineups makes each game a unique experience.

No bladder matches: 6-player battles accelerate the pace, offering high-frequency strategic combat in 10-15 minute sessions.

Simplified Chinese*, English
*languages with full audio support
